name: Giyim 030 — Satışlar POS varyant seçimi
description: Demo Giyim (030) Satışlar POS’ta varyantlı ürün seçildiğinde beden/renk seçimi veya varyantlı ürün görünür.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the RetailEX login page
Connect tenant retailex_demo if needed, then sign in as admin / admin
Select firm Demo Giyim (030), pick a store if needed, and enter the app
Click the top shell module labeled Satışlar
On the POS product grid or catalog, locate a variant product such as TSHIRT-VAR or a clothing item with variants
Click that product to open variant selection if prompted
Verify either a size/color variant picker is shown for the product, or the product is added with a clear variant attribute — POS remains usable without error
